title: Informational leaflets — Leaflet formats & cover series
slide_intent: Teach designers to preserve a clear subject as a cover changes proportion and to distinguish titles within a series.
strategic_value: A program can make several guides recognizable as relatives through a shared curve while color and photography identify the subject of each issue.
demonstration: The upper row reframes an athlete and competition title across three aspect ratios. The lower row changes subject, image and color across four portrait guides.
practical_value: Choose the photograph and crop for each format, then assign related hues to distinguish individual guides in the series.

content_islands.name: Format notes
content_islands.spec: Number the guidance on changing proportions, selecting photographs, using series color and reversing the mark.

content_islands.name: Aspect-ratio study
content_islands.spec: Arrange narrow, wider portrait and landscape covers on a common row. Keep the picture, title field and mark visible in each proportion.

content_islands.name: Publication series
content_islands.spec: Line up four covers underneath. Vary color and photography while keeping the curve and accredited mark in corresponding roles.
